gates.description: All state-changing functions must follow CEI pattern — checks first, effects second, interactions last
ReentrancyGuard or equivalent must be applied to all functions that make external calls
Fuzz tests using Foundry or equivalent must be written to find edge cases in numeric logic
External security audit must be completed before mainnet deployment — no exceptions for contracts holding value
Admin and upgrade functions must be controlled by multi-sig wallet — no single key control of production contracts
If contract is upgradeable, upgrade mechanism and governance process must be documented

anti_patterns.description: Shipping unaudited smart contracts that control user funds — one vulnerability means permanent loss
Copying smart contract code without understanding the security model — vulnerabilities transfer with the code
Claiming decentralization while a single admin key can rug the protocol — users assume trust that does not exist
Integer overflow/underflow vulnerabilities in Solidity pre-0.8 contracts or unchecked blocks
Using on-chain spot price as oracle without TWAP or circuit breakers — flash loan attack vector

escalation_triggers: Security vulnerability discovered in deployed contract holding user funds
Audit report identifies critical vulnerabilities that require redesign
Admin key compromise or loss for a production contract
Protocol governance attack or governance deadlock
Regulatory requirement that conflicts with on-chain immutability
Cross-chain bridge vulnerability affecting protocol assets

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with protocol requirements, tokenomics, and security constraints

output_certifications: All state-changing functions follow CEI pattern
ReentrancyGuard applied to all functions with external calls
